content:
Earlier this year, we learned that Volvo plans to support features like Apple Music spatial audio through a CarPlay update. Volvo has once again confirmed support today and announced the detailed rollout timeline for this audio upgrade.

Back in January, Volvo pledged to continue supporting Apple CarPlay, even as some automakers like GM have scaled back support in certain models. At that time, we also mentioned that the Volvo EX60 would support spatial audio via CarPlay.

Today, Volvo revealed new details about the spatial audio feature, particularly for the EX90:

The latest software update also brings spatial audio support with CarPlay* to the Volvo EX90, paired with Dolby Atmos technology. Through a premium Bowers & Wilkins sound system equipped with 25 high-performance speakers, Volvo drivers can enjoy a multidimensional, immersive audio experience, with music and vocals enveloping the entire cabin. Whether it's a favourite song, a live performance, or a podcast, Dolby Atmos-powered spatial audio adds depth and detail to everything you listen to — making every drive richer, more engaging, and more enjoyable.

Volvo added: "Spatial audio on CarPlay requires the Bowers & Wilkins sound system to deliver the full immersive experience. Buyers can opt for it when ordering the Volvo EX60, EX90, and ES90."

Not planning to buy a new car? Pioneer earlier launched the first aftermarket CarPlay system that supports Dolby Atmos spatial audio playback.
